description: This file defines a service factory that provides domain services for user authentication, user management, courses, categories, enrollments, and progress. It supports both remote API-based services and localStorage mocks, switching based on environment flags.

methods.name: hasRemoteEnabled
methods.description: Checks environment variables to determine if remote API services are enabled.

methods.name: remoteAuthService
methods.description: Provides remote authentication methods: login, register, me, logout.

methods.name: remoteUsersService
methods.description: Provides remote user management methods: list, get, create, update, remove.

methods.name: remoteCoursesService
methods.description: Provides remote course listing, get, create, update, remove methods, backed by DummyJSON.

methods.name: remoteCategoriesService
methods.description: Provides remote category listing, get, create, update, remove methods, backed by DummyJSON.

methods.name: remoteEnrollmentsService
methods.description: Provides remote enrollment management methods: list, get, create, update, remove.

methods.name: remoteProgressService
methods.description: Provides progress tracking methods, using localStorage to simulate persistence.

methods.name: localCrud
methods.description: Creates mock CRUD services using localStorage for data persistence.

methods.name: localAuthService
methods.description: Provides local authentication mock methods: login, register, me, logout.

methods.name: getServices
methods.description: Factory function that returns either remote or local services based on environment flags.
